items.title: McDonald's (MCD) Exit From A 90% Restaurant Stake Still Haunts Investors

The company sold its stake as part of a refocus on its core fast food operations, leaving Chipotle to list and expand independently. A recent look back highlights how much long-term market value McDonald's did not capture by selling its Chipotle holding.
